newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-S.E.TRANSVAAL BEAT BOLAND 22-19.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-S.E.TRANSVAAL BEAT BOLAND 22-19.

text.p: South-Eastern Transvaal edged into third place in the A section of the Currie Cup after beating close rivals Boland 22-19 (halftime 14-3) in their rugby match on Saturday.
Boland began the day lying in third position on the table after last Saturday's 16-11 victory over Western Transvaal but they faded in the final quarter of a closely contested encounter.
South-Easterns ran in two tries through number eight Oorlog Oosthuizen and fullback Polla Nel to post their fifth victory of the season in the competition.

In a match which was hard-fought up front but saw little enterprising play from the respective threequarter lines, Boland's try-scorers were fullback Stefan Terreblanche and lock forward Johan Swanepoel.
South-Eastern Transvaal - Tries: Oorlog Oosthuizen, Polla Nel. Penalties: Clive Terreblanche (4).
Boland - Tries: Stefan Terreblanche, Johan Swanepoel. Penalties: Francois Horn (3).
